t:
Oct 29, 2026 (evening): viral reels, soft-fade pass + Bennett notes on all 108
- New rules from Bennett today (all in memory): no box around hooks, hooks small (soft top fade or full-width strip); minimal on-screen text, no labels people can figure out; safe zone is where NOT to put the thing people must find, scenes fill the frame; hook gives a job or real question, then break expectations with something random and feel-good; no more "choose your guide" style hooks; STRENGTH never STRONG; never stand characters on water/fountains; gags one at a time; physics must look real; any shove = clear attack animation and the shover stops ~1s; Hollow is the main character (never mean, no teeth).
- Numbering note: there is no reel #74 or #94. In Bennett's 81-108 notes, his 94-107 = files 095-108 (his "105 what's she making" = 106 Joy).
- Approved and posted/swapped into Metricool today (bytes verified on every post): #6, #7 (STRENGTH), #12, #14, #16, #18, #21, #26, #30, #34, #38, #40, #42, #44, #60, #72, #75, #77, #83, #87, #93, #95, #96, plus reworks #17, #23, #25, #43, #45, #49. #88 cut (posts paused, not deleted) and #100 took its Nov 7 6pm slot. #103 cut. Still to swap once final: #27, #36, #47, #51, #58, #64, #81, #82, #85, #89, #90 and hook-only reels.
- Reworks done today (in the review file for Bennett): race_v4 "Can you find the cheater?" (Rayleigh bribes the slime, sepia flashback), #10, #11, #13, #19, #20, #22, #24, #28, #29, #31, #32, #33, #36, #37, #39, #43, #45, #47, #48, #49, #50, #51-#55, #56-#59, #62-#64, #66, #67, #79-#82, #85, #89, #90, #98, #104, #108, steal. Each went through an independent reel-review; real catches were fixed, reviewer notes that contradicted Bennett were dropped.
- Hook pass: every reel's hook audited (pixellab/safezone/HOOKS.md); 19 hook-only re-renders running (approved ones get posted directly per Bennett).
- Idea lists for approved reels: IDEAS_approved.md (built #29, #27, #37, #36 on Bennett's OK) and IDEAS_56_80.md (#70, #73, #61, #77 waiting on Bennett).
- Open calls for Bennett: race gummy colour (orange melatonin vs Cyrus) and hook colour; Rayleigh is the sneaky one in both race_v4 and the thief reel; #45 Q4 swapped to MELEE/MAGIC; #47 payoff word CARRIED; #24 sits still ~6s by his "everything else the same"; #20 board mirrored left-right; #29 powers now mostly on Cyrus.
- Caption music credits: some reels were remixed with new tracks, so a few caption credit lines (e.g. #47's "Start the Day by Lee Rosevere") no longer match; audit running (MUSIC_CREDITS_AUDIT.md) and captions get fixed before those slots post.
- Process notes: mux with fork_hfg5/mux2.sh (keeps every frame); disk hit 0 once from parallel renders, freed ~3.7G by deleting old zips/frames (no work lost).
